story: Raju Robo, a fun-loving robot, is excited to explore a new world by rearranging its body parts through a fun transformation.
script:
Enduku ra mechanical text books chustav, update avvu!
Raju Robo cheppina: 'Ee robot nenu vellalani modi vachhe.. package mode aina pettuku..!' - Sound effect: Robot gears whirring, mechanical sounds.
Endi, chetiki robot box cheppina: 'Raju Robo.. Nenu chustunna.. package moddu chese?' - Sound effect: A 'beep' sound for the robot's reaction.
Raju Robo: 'Ae vachhe..! Mechanical text book kuda chesina!' - Sound effect: A 'ding' sound as the pieces reassemble.
Ee box moddu.. Raju Robo nunchi vellalana!" - Sound effect: Exciting music starts playing, and Raju Robo transforms into a robot with a new body.
Cheyyandi, Raju Robo ki velli!
title: 🚀🔥 RAJU ROBO CHANGED GAME! Raju Robo Moddi Petti 💥😍
